domain.marine_computation_scope: within fixed full raster: formal sea AND (AMAP OR latitude<=70N)
domain.outside_AMAP_assumed_ice_free: formal sea AND NOT AMAP AND latitude<=70N

native_missing_interpolation.algorithm: projected Delaunay triangulation with barycentric linear interpolation
native_missing_interpolation.support: native source-ocean finite values for each variable independently
native_missing_interpolation.source_land_treatment: masked as unavailable before interpolation; reconstructed values not original model ocean output

resampling.algorithm: projected Delaunay barycentric linear interpolation from reconstructed native grid

routine_feasibility_tests.note: one-off blocked-node, all-ice-free connectivity and daily reinforcement tests remain pilot evidence, not standard preprocessing steps

one_month_implementation.current_result_directory: 数据选优\PIOMAS_2025年1月_插值掩膜预实验\AMAP外70N以南无冰_无10km缓冲

source_calendar_note: PIOMAS has 365 source daily fields per year; keep source day indices and calendar metadata explicit. The January pilot does not define a fabricated leap-year extra day.

ice_pair_correction.spatial_scope: AMAP sea only, excluding fixed departures
ice_pair_correction.rules: Set anomalies to zero in both variables, then replace using joint means of valid paired donors at the first occupied four-neighbor sea distance. Exclude forced ice-free and residual zero-fill donors.
